# Learn Supabase
Last updated: 2026-07-30T04:56:27.550Z

## Overview
Library of components for your project. The components integrate with Supabase and are shadcn compatible.

## Docs
- [Architecture](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/architecture)
    - Learn how Supabase's core products work together.
- [Authentication](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/authentication)
    - Learn how to manage users, and how signed-in requests connect to the database.
- [Data Fundamentals](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/data-fundamentals)
    - 'Learn how data is structured in Postgres: tables, rows, columns, and keys.'
- [Edge Functions](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/edge-functions)
    - 'Learn how to run custom backend logic close to your users, using Deno and the Supabase serverless runtime.'
- [Supabase Foundations](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations)
    - Learn the foundations of Supabase, the Postgres development platform.
- [Supabase Foundations](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/introduction)
    - Learn the foundations of Supabase, the Postgres development platform.
- [Quick Start](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/quickstart)
    - Install shadcn/ui and use the components in your project
- [Realtime](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/realtime)
    - 'Learn how to build real-time applications with Supabase.'
- [Security](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/security)
    - Learn how Supabase uses Row Level Security (RLS) to control which data each user can access.
- [Storage](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/storage)
    - 'Learn how to store files in Supabase using buckets.'
- [Vector Search](https://supabase.com/library/docs/foundations/vector)
    - 'Learn how to store and query embeddings for AI-powered search and recommendations.'
- [Grafana](https://supabase.com/library/docs/internal/foundations/grafana)
    - 'Learn how to use Grafana'
- [Realtime](https://supabase.com/library/docs/internal/foundations/realtime)
    - 'Learn how to build real-time applications with Supabase.'
- [Platform Kit](https://supabase.com/library/docs/platform/platform-kit)
    - The easiest way to build platforms on top of Supabase
